    const isMobile = function () {

    };

    // gate the marquee countdown bar to non-desktop only.
    const isBelowDesktop = function () {

    // releases. Durations are tunable per ad-ops.
    const MARQUEE_STICKY_DURATION = 2000;
    const MARQUEE_MOBILE_HOLD = 2500;

    // =========================================================================

    // =========================================================================

    // is temporary; a hidden ad; a released marquee). global.css reads it as
    // `scroll-padding-top` so #anchor jumps land below the ad; Header.astro,
    // scrollToViewportTop and the regwall read it through

    // event rather than observing the ad themselves.

    function publishPinnedHeight() {

      if (height === publishedHeight) return;

        '--header-ad-pinned-height',
        height + 'px'
      );
      document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('tdb:header-ad-pinned-height'));
    }

    // Mobile pin (HeaderAd's `max-md:data-[pinned]:sticky`)
    // =========================================================================

    let pinReleased = false;
    function setPinned(pinned) {

      else delete headerWrap.dataset.pinned;

    // =========================================================================

      // pin depends on these listeners.

        // permanently pinned by CSS.
        window.googletag
          .pubads()
          .addEventListener('slotOnload', function (event) {
            const targetingId = event.slot.getSlotElementId();
            if (targetingId && targetingId.includes('-header') && !isMobile()) {
              activateSticky();
            }
          });

        window.googletag
          .pubads()
          .addEventListener('impressionViewable', function (event) {
            const targetingId = event.slot.getSlotElementId();

            if (targetingId && targetingId.includes('-header')) {
              removeSticky();
            }

    // =========================================================================
    // Init
    // =========================================================================

    // One observer for both: the creative's growth (marquee) and the
    // wrapper's own size (hidden/shown, taller marquee, breakpoint changes).

          onAdResize(entries[i].contentRect.height);
        }
      }
      publishPinnedHeight();
    });

  (function () {
    const headerWrap = document.getElementById('header-ad__wrapper');
    if (!headerWrap) return;
    const adWrap = headerWrap.querySelector('.tdb-ad');

    const mobileQuery = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 767px)');
    const isMobile = function () {
      return mobileQuery.matches;
    };
    // Below the desktop breakpoint (layoutConfig.breakpoints.lg = 1024). Used to
    // gate the marquee countdown bar to non-desktop only.
    const isBelowDesktop = function () {
      return window.innerWidth < 1024;
    };

    const MINIMUM_STICKY_DURATION = 2000;
    const BACKUP_TIMER_DURATION = 4000;
    // Oversized "marquee" creatives get a longer pinned hold (plus a countdown
    // bar) so the taller unit gets a clearly-signalled viewable window before it
    // releases. Durations are tunable per ad-ops.
    const MARQUEE_STICKY_DURATION = 2000;
    const MARQUEE_MOBILE_HOLD = 2500;

    // =========================================================================
    // Pinned height: published for anchor jumps, the scroll nav and helpers
    // =========================================================================

    // `--header-ad-pinned-height` on <html>: the ad's height while the mobile
    // pin holds it at the viewport top, else 0 (tablet/desktop, where the pin
    // is temporary; a hidden ad; a released marquee). global.css reads it as
    // `scroll-padding-top` so #anchor jumps land below the ad; Header.astro,
    // scrollToViewportTop and the regwall read it through
    // `lib/utils/pinnedHeaderAdHeight`, which owns these names, and follow the
    // event rather than observing the ad themselves.
    let publishedHeight = null;
    function publishPinnedHeight() {
      const pinned =
        isMobile() && getComputedStyle(headerWrap).position === 'sticky';
      const height = pinned ? headerWrap.offsetHeight : 0;
      if (height === publishedHeight) return;
      publishedHeight = height;
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
        '--header-ad-pinned-height',
        height + 'px'
      );
      document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('tdb:header-ad-pinned-height'));
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // Mobile pin (HeaderAd's `max-md:data-[pinned]:sticky`)
    // =========================================================================

    // Set once a marquee has been released, so a later refill can't re-pin it.
    let pinReleased = false;
    function setPinned(pinned) {
      if (pinned && !pinReleased) headerWrap.dataset.pinned = 'true';
      else delete headerWrap.dataset.pinned;
      publishPinnedHeight();
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // Shared: animated sticky removal
    // =========================================================================

    // Tracked so a re-pin (marquee) can cancel an in-flight slide-out before it
    // strips the sticky classes.
    let removeAnimTimer = null;

    function animateAndRemoveClasses(classes, onComplete) {
      const scrollPosition =
        window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
      const headerAdHeight = headerWrap.offsetHeight;

      if (scrollPosition > headerAdHeight) {
        headerWrap.style.transition = 'transform 0.3s ease-in-out';
        headerWrap.style.transform = 'translateY(-100%)';
      }

        removeAnimTimer = null;

        headerWrap.style.transition = '';

      timerBar = document.createElement('div');

    // would cover much of the screen (and the reserved height never shrinks,
    // so a later 320x50 refresh wouldn't bring it back down).

        if (isMobile()) animateAndRemoveClasses([], unpin);
        else unpin();

    }

    // Reserve the tallest observed creative height (CLS prevention) so a later,
    // shorter creative can't collapse the header slot and shift the article.
    // Height only ever grows; the ad is centered in the reserved space. An
    // oversized (marquee) creative additionally gets its held window (once).
    // Detection is height-based: mobile baselines at 50 (standard 320x50),
    // desktop at the initial wrapper offsetHeight, so anything taller counts as
    // a marquee.
    // NOTE: append #sponsor=marqueemobtest to the URL to test a marquee
    let previousHeight = isMobile() ? 50 : headerWrap.offsetHeight;

      if (height <= previousHeight) return;

      adWrap.style.minHeight = height + 'px';
      adWrap.style.display = 'flex';
      adWrap.style.justifyContent = 'center';
      adWrap.style.alignItems = 'center';

      else if (getComputedStyle(headerWrap).position === 'sticky') {

    // GPT stick-for-viewability handling (tablet + desktop)
    // =========================================================================

    const STICKY_CLASSES = ['sticky', 'top-0', 'z-100'];
    let backupTimer = null;
    let minimumVisibilityTimer = null;
    let hasActivated = false;
    let hasRemoved = false;
    let activationTime = null;

    function activateSticky() {
      if (hasActivated) return;

      hasRemoved = false;

      // re-adding (matters when a marquee re-pins mid-removal).

    function removeSticky() {

      const minDuration = marqueeHandled

      if (timeRemaining > 0) {

        return;
      }

      hasRemoved = true;

      if (backupTimer) clearTimeout(backupTimer);
      if (minimumVisibilityTimer) clearTimeout(minimumVisibilityTimer);

      // Rotated into the mobile layout while pinned: the permanent CSS pin has
      // taken over, so drop the classes without sliding the ad away.
      if (isMobile()) {
        headerWrap.classList.remove.apply(headerWrap.classList, STICKY_CLASSES);
        removeTimerBar();
        return;
      }

      animateAndRemoveClasses(STICKY_CLASSES, removeTimerBar);
    }

    function initGPTStickyHandling() {
      // Queue on GPT's command array even if GPT hasn't loaded yet: the mobile
      // pin depends on these listeners.
      window.googletag = window.googletag || { cmd: [] };
      window.googletag.cmd = window.googletag.cmd || [];

      window.googletag.cmd.push(function () {
        if (!window.googletag.pubads) return;

        // Mobile pin follows whether the header slot actually rendered.
        window.googletag
          .pubads()
          .addEventListener('slotRenderEnded', function (event) {
            const targetingId = event.slot.getSlotElementId();
            if (targetingId && targetingId.includes('-header')) {
              setPinned(!event.isEmpty);
            }
          });

        // Activate sticky when header ad loads. Not on mobile, where it is
        // permanently pinned by CSS.
        window.googletag
          .pubads()
          .addEventListener('slotOnload', function (event) {
            const targetingId = event.slot.getSlotElementId();
            if (targetingId && targetingId.includes('-header') && !isMobile()) {
              activateSticky();
            }
          });

        // Remove sticky when header ad impression is viewable
        window.googletag
          .pubads()
          .addEventListener('impressionViewable', function (event) {
            const targetingId = event.slot.getSlotElementId();
            // Note: ID is set by AY, ex: article-header__ayManagerEnv__1_6WzpXsYQ
            if (targetingId && targetingId.includes('-header')) {
              removeSticky();
            }
          });
      });
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // Init
    // =========================================================================

    // One observer for both: the creative's growth (marquee) and the
    // wrapper's own size (hidden/shown, taller marquee, breakpoint changes).
    publishPinnedHeight();
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(function (entries) {
      for (let i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
        if (entries[i].target === adWrap) {
          onAdResize(entries[i].contentRect.height);
        }
      }
      publishPinnedHeight();
    });
    observer.observe(headerWrap);
    if (adWrap) observer.observe(adWrap);
    mobileQuery.addEventListener('change', publishPinnedHeight);

    initGPTStickyHandling();

    const isMobile = function () {

    const BACKUP_TIMER_DURATION = 4000;
    // Oversized "marquee" creatives get a longer pinned hold (plus a countdown
    // bar) so the taller unit gets a clearly-signalled viewable window before it
    // releases. Durations are tunable per ad-ops.
    const MARQUEE_STICKY_DURATION = 2000;
    const MARQUEE_MOBILE_HOLD = 2500;

    // =========================================================================
    // Pinned height: published for anchor jumps, the scroll nav and helpers
    // =========================================================================

    // `--header-ad-pinned-height` on <html>: the ad's height while the mobile
    // pin holds it at the viewport top, else 0 (tablet/desktop, where the pin
    // is temporary; a hidden ad; a released marquee). global.css reads it as
    // `scroll-padding-top` so #anchor jumps land below the ad; Header.astro,
    // scrollToViewportTop and the regwall read it through

    // event rather than observing the ad themselves.
    let publishedHeight = null;
    function publishPinnedHeight() {

      if (height === publishedHeight) return;

        '--header-ad-pinned-height',
        height + 'px'

      document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('tdb:header-ad-pinned-height'));
    }

    // Mobile pin (HeaderAd's `max-md:data-[pinned]:sticky`)
    // =========================================================================

    let pinReleased = false;
    function setPinned(pinned) {

      publishPinnedHeight();

    // =========================================================================

    function animateAndRemoveClasses(classes, onComplete) {

    // shorter creative can't collapse the header slot and shift the article.
    // Height only ever grows; the ad is centered in the reserved space. An

    // Detection is height-based: mobile baselines at 50 (standard 320x50),
    // desktop at the initial wrapper offsetHeight, so anything taller counts as

    // =========================================================================

    let backupTimer = null;
    let minimumVisibilityTimer = null;

      // taken over, so drop the classes without sliding the ad away.
      if (isMobile()) {

        return;
      }

      animateAndRemoveClasses(STICKY_CLASSES, removeTimerBar);
    }

      // pin depends on these listeners.
      window.googletag = window.googletag || { cmd: [] };
      window.googletag.cmd = window.googletag.cmd || [];

      window.googletag.cmd.push(function () {
        if (!window.googletag.pubads) return;

            const targetingId = event.slot.getSlotElementId();
            if (targetingId && targetingId.includes('-header')) {

            }
          });

        // permanently pinned by CSS.
        window.googletag
          .pubads()
          .addEventListener('slotOnload', function (event) {
            const targetingId = event.slot.getSlotElementId();
            if (targetingId && targetingId.includes('-header') && !isMobile()) {
              activateSticky();
            }
          });

        // Remove sticky when header ad impression is viewable
        window.googletag
          .pubads()
          .addEventListener('impressionViewable', function (event) {
            const targetingId = event.slot.getSlotElementId();
            // Note: ID is set by AY, ex: article-header__ayManagerEnv__1_6WzpXsYQ
            if (targetingId && targetingId.includes('-header')) {
              removeSticky();
            }
          });
      });
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // Init
    // =========================================================================

    // One observer for both: the creative's growth (marquee) and the
    // wrapper's own size (hidden/shown, taller marquee, breakpoint changes).
    publishPinnedHeight();
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(function (entries) {
      for (let i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
        if (entries[i].target === adWrap) {
          onAdResize(entries[i].contentRect.height);
        }
      }
      publishPinnedHeight();
    });
    observer.observe(headerWrap);
    if (adWrap) observer.observe(adWrap);
    mobileQuery.addEventListener('change', publishPinnedHeight);

    initGPTStickyHandling();
  })();

      if (backupTimer) clearTimeout(backupTimer);

      // taken over, so drop the classes without sliding the ad away.

        return;
      }

      animateAndRemoveClasses(STICKY_CLASSES, removeTimerBar);
    }

      // pin depends on these listeners.

      window.googletag.cmd = window.googletag.cmd || [];

      window.googletag.cmd.push(function () {
        if (!window.googletag.pubads) return;

          .pubads()

              activateSticky();

        window.googletag
          .pubads()
          .addEventListener('impressionViewable', function (event) {

            }

    // =========================================================================
    // Init
    // =========================================================================

    // wrapper's own size (hidden/shown, taller marquee, breakpoint changes).
    publishPinnedHeight();
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(function (entries) {
      for (let i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
        if (entries[i].target === adWrap) {
          onAdResize(entries[i].contentRect.height);
        }
      }
      publishPinnedHeight();
    });
    observer.observe(headerWrap);
    if (adWrap) observer.observe(adWrap);
    mobileQuery.addEventListener('change', publishPinnedHeight);

<meta name="sentry-route-name" content="%2F%5Bslug%5D"/><meta charset="UTF-8"><script>(function(){const config = {"marketing":false};

  (function () {
    var CLIENT_RENDERED = ['custom', 'regwall', 'paywall'];

    function decidedWall() {
      var injected = window._zephr && window._zephr.wall;
      var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      var forced = params.get('wall');

      // The `?wall=` dev escape hatch, mirroring `decidedWall` in `wall.ts`.
      if (CLIENT_RENDERED.indexOf(forced) >= 0) {
        return {
          wall_type: forced,
          user_type: (injected && injected.user_type) || 'anonymous',
          wall_name: params.get('wall_name') || undefined,
        };
      }

      if (!injected || CLIENT_RENDERED.indexOf(injected.wall_type) < 0) return;

      return injected;
    }

    // Mirrors `findFormTransformation` in `wall.ts`: the zone is a console
    // setting we do not control, so take the first transformation carrying a
    // `resourceId` whichever zone it lands in, and fall back to the unzoned
    // array.
    function findFormTransform(transform) {
      var zones = transform.zonedTransformations;

      if (zones) {
        for (var zone in zones) {
          var found = (zones[zone] || []).filter(function (item) {
            return item.resourceId;
          })[0];
          if (found) return found;
        }
      }

      return (transform.transformations || []).filter(function (item) {
        return item.resourceId;
      })[0];
    }

    // Mirrors `mountZephrForm` in `lib/zephr/zephr-form.ts`, which explains
    // why: `innerHTML` never runs scripts, so each is re-created in place.
    function mountForm(slot, html) {
      slot.innerHTML = html;

      var scripts = slot.querySelectorAll('script');
      for (var i = 0; i < scripts.length; i++) {
        var original = scripts[i];
        var script = document.createElement('script');
        for (var a = 0; a < original.attributes.length; a++) {
          script.setAttribute(
            original.attributes[a].name,
            original.attributes[a].value
          );
        }
        script.textContent = original.textContent;
        original.parentNode.replaceChild(script, original);
      }
    }

    // Until `Wall` hydrates, nothing is listening for plan picks, and Zephr's
    // own handler would take the reader into its payment steps. Capture phase,
    // so it runs before that handler — the same interception `onZephrPlanSelect`
    // does. Once `Wall` owns the slot it stands aside.
    function holdPlanClicks(slot) {
      slot.addEventListener(
        'click',
        function (event) {
          if (slot.hasAttribute('data-zephr-wall-owner')) return;

          var card =
            event.target.closest &&
            event.target.closest('.payment-option-wrapper');
          if (!card || !slot.contains(card)) return;

          event.stopPropagation();
          event.preventDefault();
          window.__zephrWallPendingClick = card;
        },
        true
      );
    }

    // Mirrors `pushWallShownEvent` / `wallContext` in `Wall.tsx`: the same
    // three events with the same context, so a report from here and one from
    // `Wall` land in the same rows. Sent here, as the form mounts, because
    // `Wall` hydrates `client:visible` — left to it, the impression would only
    // be counted once the reader scrolled down to the wall. The slot is marked
    // so `Wall` does not report it again when it adopts the form.
    var FORM_ID = {
      custom: 'standard-paywall',
      regwall: 'standard-regwall',
      paywall: 'standard-paywall',
      marketing: 'standard-paywall',
    };

    function reportShown(slot, wall) {
      var context = {
        formType: wall.wall_type === 'regwall' ? 'REGISTRATION' : 'PAYMENT',
        formId: FORM_ID[wall.wall_type],
        outcomeId: wall.outcome_label || wall.wall_name || '',
      };

      slot.setAttribute('data-zephr-wall-reported', '');

      // Mirrors `pushZephrEvents` in `lib/gtm/zephrTestGroups`: held for the
      // reader's test groups until the Zephr datalayer has them. A reader
      // with no session has none, so there is nothing to wait for.
      if (
        window.__zephrTestGroups === undefined &&
        !/blaize_session=[A-Za-z0-9_-]+/.test(document.cookie)
      ) {
        window.__zephrTestGroups = '{}';
      }

      // GTM's snippet may not have run yet; it drains whatever is queued.
      var dataLayer = (window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || []);
      var pending = (window.__zephrPendingEvents =
        window.__zephrPendingEvents || []);
      var testGroups = window.__zephrTestGroups;
      ['zephr_form_render', 'zephr_wall_shown', 'zephr_form_view'].forEach(
        function (event) {
          var item = Object.assign({ event: event }, context);
          if (testGroups === undefined) {
            pending.push(item);
          } else {
            item.zephr_test_groups = testGroups;
            dataLayer.push(item);
          }
        }
      );

      if (testGroups === undefined) armSettle();
    }

    // Mirrors `settleZephrTestGroups` in `lib/gtm/zephrTestGroups`, and its
    // wait (`ZEPHR_TEST_GROUPS_MAX_WAIT_MS`). The module normally flushes what
    // was held above once the Zephr datalayer answers, but it arms its own
    // fallbacks only once it has hydrated. Until then, these make sure a
    // reader who leaves early, or a bundle that never loads, doesn't lose the
    // impression — the same guarantee as pushing it straight to `dataLayer`.
    var settleArmed = false;

    function settle() {
      if (window.__zephrTestGroups !== undefined) return;
      window.__zephrTestGroups = '{}';
      var held = window.__zephrPendingEvents || [];
      window.__zephrPendingEvents = [];
      var dataLayer = (window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || []);
      held.forEach(function (item) {
        dataLayer.push(
          'event' in item
            ? Object.assign({}, item, { zephr_test_groups: '{}' })
            : item
        );
      });
    }

    function armSettle() {
      if (settleArmed) return;
      settleArmed = true;
      window.setTimeout(settle, 5000);
      window.addEventListener('pagehide', settle, { once: true });
    }

    // Mirrors `withWallLoginLink` in `lib/zephr/zephr-form.ts`, which explains
    // why: `returnTo` for anonymous readers, no link for anyone else.
    var LOGIN_LINK_COMPONENT = '"type":"show_login_link"';
    var RELATIVE_BASE = 'https://relative.invalid';

    // Mirrors `withReturnTo`: replaces any `returnTo` already on the URL
    // rather than adding a second one, and keeps a relative URL relative.
    function withReturnTo(url, returnTo) {
      var parsed = new URL(url, RELATIVE_BASE);
      parsed.searchParams.set('returnTo', returnTo);

      return parsed.origin === RELATIVE_BASE
        ? parsed.pathname + parsed.search + parsed.hash
        : parsed.href;
    }

    function withWallLoginLink(html, userType) {
      var start = html.indexOf(LOGIN_LINK_COMPONENT);
      if (start < 0) return html;

      var next = html.indexOf('"type":', start + LOGIN_LINK_COMPONENT.length);
      var end = next < 0 ? html.length : next;
      var component = html.slice(start, end);
      var returnTo = window.location.pathname + window.location.search;

      var rewritten =
        userType === 'anonymous'
          ? component.replace(/"url":"([^"]*)"/, function (_, url) {
              return '"url":"' + withReturnTo(url, returnTo) + '"';
            })
          : component.replace('"enabled":true', '"enabled":false');

      return html.slice(0, start) + rewritten + html.slice(end);
    }

    // Returns whether the slot was found, mounted or not, so the caller knows
    // whether to wait for the parser. `wall` is the decision, or the
    // membership page's `{ wall_type: 'marketing' }`.
    function mountEarly(wall, html) {
      var slot = document.querySelector(
        '[data-zephr-wall-slot~="' + wall.wall_type + '"]'
      );
      if (!slot) return false;

      // `Wall` got here first, or already mounted — leave it to it.
      if (slot.hasChildNodes() || slot.hasAttribute('data-zephr-wall-owner')) {
        return true;
      }

      try {
        mountForm(slot, html);
        holdPlanClicks(slot);
      } catch (error) {
        // A half-mounted form would be adopted as a whole one. Empty the slot
        // and let `Wall` mount it from scratch after hydration.
        console.error('[zephr] early wall mount failed', error);
        slot.innerHTML = '';
        return true;
      }

      // Outside the `try`: a failed report is no reason to unmount the form.
      //
      // Not while `Wall` has marked the slot hidden (`WALL_INACTIVE` — the
      // regwall's Subscribe tab, with Register open): `Wall` reports it when
      // the slot is first shown, which it can only do if this leaves
      // `data-zephr-wall-reported` unset.
      if (slot.hasAttribute('data-zephr-wall-inactive')) return true;

      try {
        reportShown(slot, wall);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('[zephr] early wall report failed', error);
      }

      return true;
    }

    // Both decisions and the form they name, as one promise that resolves the
    // form's markup or `undefined` — never rejects, since `wall.ts` treats
    // `undefined` as "Zephr had nothing" and shows the hardcoded plans, and an
    // unhandled rejection would be one more Sentry issue per pageview for a
    // Zephr outage. Mounts into `wall`'s slot as soon as the markup is in.
    function preloadForm(feature, path, wall) {
      // Same character class as the gateway's session regex (`zephr-sdk.ts`),
      // so both paths read the same session and get the same decision.
      var session = /blaize_session=([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)/.exec(document.cookie);
      var payload = { sdkFeatureSlug: feature, path: path };
      if (session) payload.session = session[1];

      return fetch('/zephr/decision-engine', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        credentials: 'include',
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
        priority: 'high',
      })
        .then(function (response) {
          if (!response.ok) throw new Error('decision ' + response.status);
          return response.json();
        })
        .then(function (decision) {
          var transform = JSON.parse(decision.outputValue);
          var form = transform && findFormTransform(transform);
          if (!form) return;

          // The membership page has no gateway decision, so its outcome is
          // this one's — set before mounting, so `reportShown` sends it as
          // `outcomeId`. Mirrors `loadMarketingForm`. A wall keeps the
          // gateway's `outcome_label`.
          if (wall.wall_type === 'marketing' && transform.outcomeLabel) {
            wall.outcome_label = transform.outcomeLabel;
          }

          return fetch(form.resourcePath, { priority: 'high' }).then(
            function (response) {
              // A republished form takes a new resource id, so a 404 here is
              // routine and its body is an error page — never markup to mount.
              if (!response.ok) throw new Error('form ' + response.status);
              return response.text();
            }
          );
        })
        .then(function (html) {
          if (!html) return;

          // Before mounting, and on what `wall.ts` adopts: headless sends its
          // own `zephr_form_*` events, so the bundle's are switched off.
          html = html.replace(
            /"trackFormDataLayerEvents":\s*(?:true|false)/,
            '"trackFormDataLayerEvents":false'
          );
